com.invoiceparserpro/capability.description: Allocate a whole invoice or one selected printed line to a load number. Keeps other allocations and the invoice amounts unchanged. Review and confirm the exact change first. The preview expires after five minutes.
examples: Preview allocating the whole invoice we selected to the load number we chose. Show existing allocations and wait for my confirmation.
Preview assigning only the printed-line index we identified to the selected load number, keeping other allocations. Wait for my confirmation.

annotations.title: Allocate invoice cost to a load

description: Apply only the exact change returned by preview_assign_invoice_load, after the user confirms that preview. Accepts its confirmation_token only; changed or expired records require a new preview. Prepare assigning a whole invoice or exact printed-line index to a load number. Other allocations remain. Does not change invoice amounts. Requires confirmation.

confirmation_token.description: The exact token returned by this operation’s preview, after the user confirms its displayed changes.
confirmation_token.title: Confirmation Token
